newsitem.title: USA: Arbor Drugs Q1 same store sales up 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Arbor Drugs Q1 same store sales up 11 pct.

text.p: Arbor Drugs Inc said on Tuesday comparable store sales for the first quarter ended October 31 rose 11 percent.

Earlier, Arbor Drugs reported quarterly earnings of $0.25 a share, up from $0.21 a year ago. Total sales for Arbor's first quarter were $224,973,000, up 18.0 percent from $190,704,000 in the prior year.
Pharmacy sales accounted for 53.3 percent of total sales in the quarter, with comparable store pharmacy sales increasing 17.2 percent.

"We are very pleased with our excellent first quarter results, which were led by double-digit comparable store sales increases," Eugene Applebaum, Arbor's chairman, said in a statement. "In fact, this is Arbor's third consecutive quarter of double-digit sales increases for stores which have been open for one year or more."
Six new drugstores added in this quarter, including the first two in the Flint, Mich., market, exceeded expectations, he added.
For the remainder of the fiscal year, Arbor plans to open 14 more drugstores, the company said.
